73850.subject: Hausa
73850.question_text: 'Baba na cin abinci yanzu'. Kalmar suna a wannan jimla ita ce
73850.explanation: What is the noun in the sentence "Baba na cin abinci yanzu"? Answer: Baba (Baba is the noun, which means "father". Abinci is a noun, cin is verb, na is a possessive pronoun, and yanzu is an adverb)

73851.subject: Hausa
73851.question_text:
PASSAGE 2: Damukowa mutum ne wanda irin halayensa ne suka sa ake kiransa da wannan suna. Domin yana da kinibibi, da gulma, da ketti da rashin mutunci da rashin ganin kimar kowa. Kuma yana kiwon dabbobi kamar jakai da rakuma da rakuma da tumakai da kaji har da shanu. Asalin garin Damukowa shi ne Gunu wanda idan za a je garin sai an keta dazuzzuka da rafuka, kuma ana cin karo da dabbobin da kamar birai da kuraye da macizai da giwaye amma babu damisa da zaki. Idan damina ta sauka Mai unguwar Gunu kan umurci jama'a da su d'aure dabbobinsu don kar su yi barnar amfanin gonarsu kamar masara da dawa da gyada da wake amma ban da auduga domin ba sa nom ta. Nan ne fa Damukowa kan nuna halayensa na rashin ga umurnin Mai unguwa na kin daure dabbobinsa. Idan dabbobinsa sun yi barna a gonakin mutane yakan bijire wa dogaran da suka zo kama shi har ya sa a yi musu duka du keta musu tufafi, har ma da ji musu ciwo. Garin Gunu na makwabtaka da Shakwatu da Gwada da Badum da Akope. Cikin mutanen wadannan garuruwa akwai maharba da masunta da makiyaya da manoma amma babu madora.

Duk wadannan halayen Damukowa ne in ban da
73851.explanation: All of these are characteristics of Damukowa except: D

...Damukowa yana kiwon wadannan dabbobi in ban da.

73853.subject: Hausa
73853.question_text:
(Again similar passage)

Wahe abu ne mutanen garin Gunu ba su nomawa?
73853.explanation: What crop do people in Gunu not farm? Answer: Auduga (Auduga is the crop that people in Gunu do not farm. The other options - Dawa (beans), Gyada (groundnuts), Masara (maize), and Wake (rice) - are all crops that they farm)

73855.explanation: The conclusion of a letter is characterized by: Answer: kammalawa (Kammalawa means conclusion or ending, which is the correct answer. Adireshi refers to the address, gabatarwa is the introduction, gangar jiki is the body of the letter, and kanun batu is not a relevant term)

73856.subject: Hausa
73856.explanation: In a letter, the sender's address is usually followed by: Answer: adireshi na biyu (Adireshi na biyu means the recipient's address, which is the correct answer. Gabatarwa is the introduction, gaisuwa is the greeting, kanun batu is not a relevant term, and kwanan wata is the date)

73857.subject: Hausa
73857.question_text: 'Malam ya sayi mota shud'iya jiya'. Fito da sifa daga wannan jimlar.
73857.explanation: The adjective in the sentence "Malam ya sayi mota shud'iya jiya" is: Answer: Shud'iya (Shud'iya is the adjective modifying the noun mota, meaning "new". Jiya means "yesterday", Malam is the subject, mota means "car", and sayi means "to buy")

73863.explanation: In grammar, a modifier (bayanau) is a word that gives more information about: Answer: aikatau (Aikatau means "verb", and a modifier gives more information about the verb. Adadi means "number", jam'i means "plural", sifa means "adjective", and suna means "name")

73871.subject: Hausa
73871.question_text:
AUNA FAHIMTA Karanta wadannan labarai, sannan ka amsa tambayoyin da ke biye. Idan mutum ya kama sana'a, musamman a cikin sana'o'in Hausa na gargajiya tamkar ya shiga wani kulob ne. Dalili kuwa, kowace sana'ar Hausa ta gargajiya za ka iske tana da wadansu al'adu nata daban. Misali an san Mahauta a kan al'adar hawan kaho, da kuma iya mayar da magana. Sa'annan an san Makera da wasan cin-wuta, su ko Maharba kan bayar da magunguna irin na saiwa da sassake-sassake, da sauransu. Wasu sana'o'in har unguwanni gare su a cikin birane. Saboda haka idan bakon mai sana'a ya shigo gari, yakan nemi unguwar masu sana'a irin tasa ne, ya je ya zauna. Zaman irin wannan unguwar zama ne na cude-ni-in-cude-ka wajen aiki, ko a fagen kayan aiki, ko wajen dabarun samun kasuwa, da sauransu. Sa'annan dukkar sana'o'i suna da sorakuna, masu kula da zamansu a gari. Kuma su ne tsani daga masu sana'a zuwa ga hukumar gari ko kasa. Misali akwai Sarkin gini, da Galadiman gini, da Madakin gini, da Wakilin gini, da Sarkin fawa, da Wakilin fawa, da Sarkin aska, da Dangaladima, da Sarkin Makera, da sauran irinsu.

...it...i...i...i...i...i...i...i...i...i...i...i...i...
73871.explanation: The text states that Mahauta is known for the custom of 'iya mayar da magana (speaking eloquently)'

73884.explanation: Identify the modifier in the sentence. Answer: Yi (Yi is the modifier which indicates the verb "to do". Ci is a verb, Karkashi is a noun, Shaka is a noun, and Zo is a verb)
